coverage_rule: The complete catalog and source browser do not establish page or API parity. The 42 native page adaptations remain partial. Runtime load tests establish constructibility; only named interaction tests establish their bounded behaviors.

AccessibilityColorContrast.notes: The original luminance/contrast calculation and pass thresholds run in Rust. Opaque RGB text inputs replace the Gallery's custom inline color pickers; those picker controls remain pending. This reviewed subset does not establish every source example, event, binding, accessibility behavior, platform integration or visual state of the upstream page.
